title: VoiceBridge
desc: The single routing point from a voice request to an engine.
lede: Every synthesis request goes through one place: the VoiceBridge. That's what keeps engine details out of the rest of the app.
body:
At a glance
  • Routes requests to engines over HTTP.
  • A remote bridge + client talk to the TTS Server.
  • Honors engine enablement and readiness.

Routing

The bridge resolves the voice, validates readiness, builds the engine request, and normalizes the result. Nothing else calls engines directly.

Remote client

A bridge client speaks to the TTS Server over HTTP. Studio caches engine info from the server rather than importing engine code. See Plugin Architecture.
